description: This Java source file defines the ShoppingCategoryController class, a Spring MVC controller responsible for handling HTTP requests related to category pages in an e-commerce web application. It provides endpoints for displaying categories, retrieving subcategories, products, and filtering products by various criteria, managing breadcrumb navigation, caching, and integrating with service layers for categories, products, and manufacturers.

classes.name: ShoppingCategoryController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for handling category-related web requests, including displaying categories, fetching subcategories, products, filtering, and managing breadcrumbs and caching.

methods.name: displayCategoryWithReference
methods.description: Handles requests for displaying a category page with a reference parameter, delegates to displayCategory.

methods.name: displayCategoryNoReference
methods.description: Handles requests for displaying a category page without a reference, delegates to displayCategory.

methods.name: displayCategory
methods.description: Core method that builds the category page, retrieves category info, subcategories, manufacturers, manages breadcrumbs, caching, and determines the view template.

methods.name: getManufacturersByProductAndCategory
methods.description: Retrieves list of manufacturers associated with products in the specified category and subcategories, utilizing cache.

methods.name: getManufacturers
methods.description: Fetches manufacturer details for a list of category IDs.

methods.name: getProductsByCategory
methods.description: Counts products in categories and subcategories, returns a map of category ID to product count.

methods.name: getSubCategories
methods.description: Retrieves subcategories of a given category, populates product counts.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: REST endpoint returning all categories for a store and language.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: REST endpoint returning products for a category in a store, supports lineages, returns product proxies.

methods.name: getProducts (paginated)
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of products in a category.

methods.name: getProductsFilteredByType
methods.description: Filters products by brand or other criteria, delegates to getProducts with filters.

methods.name: getProducts (with filters)
methods.description: Main method that retrieves products based on pagination, filters, store, language, and category.
